chapters: About the system

Tarkastus is a universal mobile system for inspections, documenting results, professional reports and teamwork. Carry out the entire process on a phone or tablet, from the first observation and photo to a finished PDF shared with colleagues or customers.
- Free individual use without mandatory registration.
- Easy to use, independent of expensive corporate systems.
- Offline work.
- 14 languages and independent PDF language selection.
- Teamwork via Google Drive with Premium.
Areas of application

Construction and renovation, technical supervision, quality control, property management, manufacturing, equipment maintenance, service, acceptance inspections, warranty service, damage documentation, internal audits and independent professional work.
The user determines the content, purpose and level of detail of the document.
System versions
Free features and Premium

# Free individual work
All report types available in the version, document creation and editing, camera and gallery, checklists, measurements, custom fields, templates, PDF, logo and signature, customers and sites, local backup and restore, offline work and sharing finished PDFs. No registration or subscription required.
# Premium
Premium is only required for teamwork and synchronization between users via Google Drive. An active subscription also removes ads.
@price per month / user
Teamwork without expensive corporate licenses. Less than a cup of coffee.
First launch

1. Install the app.
2. Select the interface language. English is the default.
3. Proceed to report creation.
4. Open settings using the gear icon if needed.
No account or subscription is required for individual work.
System languages
Initial settings

Before regular use, enter permanent details: company name, contacts, inspector name, certificate or qualification number, logo, signature, header and footer, regular customers and sites. Reuse these details in future documents. Empty optional fields are omitted from PDF.
# Logo and signature
Upload the logo image and your own signature in settings. They are used in documents that support them. Do not give your signature to colleagues for signing on your behalf.
Customers and sites

# Add a customer
1. Open settings and regular customers.
2. Add a new customer.
3. Enter details and save.
# Add a site
Select the customer and add related sites: building, production premises, residential complex, warehouse, equipment or work area.
In a report, select the saved customer and site and specify the location if needed: building B, apartment 44, room 203 or production line 5.
Document types

Cloud provides eight document types. Pro additionally provides the dedicated waterproofing inspection report.
# 9.1. Inspection report
General report for site condition, observations, photos, recommendations and required actions.
# 9.2. Defects and deficiencies list
Document defects, damage and nonconformities: location, description, measures, responsible person, priority and deadlines.
# 9.3. Handover inspection
Acceptance of sites, equipment, premises and completed work; record condition at handover and any deficiencies.
# 9.4. Warranty inspection
Inspections during the warranty period, findings, required repairs and reinspection results.
# 9.5. Site visit report
Working visits, field inspections, current situation, problems, observations and recommendations.
# 9.6. Supervision report
Document quality and progress of work and intermediate construction and renovation inspections.
# 9.7. Custom report
Adapt the standard document structure to professional needs: name additional fields, add information and save as a template.
# 9.8. Free-form document
Create documents without a mandatory standard structure. Define title, content and additional fields. The Use settings switch enables or disables shared details. When disabled, the document need not contain automatically added inspector and company details. Suitable for instructions, explanatory notes and unconventional documents.
@problock 9.9. Waterproofing inspection report — Pro only
Dedicated wet-room document: site information, work and inspection dates, substrate condition, working conditions, primers and levelling materials, waterproofing compounds, consumption, dry film thickness, joint sealing, inspection results, photos and inspector conclusion.
Follow current requirements and instructions of the selected waterproofing system manufacturer.
@end
Create a new report

1. Select New report on the home screen.
2. Choose document type and PDF language.
3. Specify customer and site if needed.
4. Fill in the basic information.
5. Add inspection items, descriptions and required actions.
6. Add photos, measurements and additional information.
7. Review the content and create PDF.
Contents depend on the selected report type.
Inspection items

One report may contain multiple observations for rooms, equipment, defects or areas. In supported editors specify location, situation description, actions, photos, status, priority, responsible person, deadline and reinspection date. Add items as needed.
Checklists

Create inspection items and record each result. Examples: equipment operation, absence of damage, cleanliness, compliance and availability of documentation. Save the report as a template to reuse the checklist.
Measurements

Standard reports can document the parameter, measured value, unit, permitted value and inspection result. Examples: temperature, humidity, length, thickness, pressure, gap or dimensional deviation. Tarkastus records measurements; it does not replace measuring instruments.
Photos

Use Take photo for the camera and Choose photo for existing images. Attach photos to the relevant findings. Remove unnecessary photos; supported editors offer photo categories.
Standard reports place photos beside observations, up to four per page, moving them to the next page if needed. Specialized documents may use a different layout.
Custom fields

Add custom fields when standard ones are insufficient. Name each field and fill in information: serial number, contract number, air temperature, batch number, cause of damage or customer requirements.
Templates

Create a report with the required fields, checklists and structure, then save as a template. At the next inspection select the template and enter current data. Check dates, site, measurements and previous results. Personal templates are not automatically shared by synchronization.
Document organization

Use folders and subfolders to organize reports. Examples: Customers / Company A / Site 1; Customers / Company A / Site 2; Customers / Company B; Warranty inspections; Quality control; Handover inspections.
Create PDF

PDFs are generated automatically from entered data and can include logo, report title, details, customer and site, inspection results, measurement tables, checklists, photos, custom fields, signature and headers/footers. Empty optional fields are omitted.
Finished PDFs open in standard viewers, can be emailed, shared via messengers, saved on Google Drive or printed. Recipients do not need Tarkastus.
Teamwork via Google Drive

An account, active Premium and access to a shared Google Drive folder are required. The organization manages access; no separate administrator app is needed.
# Folder owner setup
1. Create a Google Drive folder.
2. Grant colleagues read and edit rights.
3. Connect the folder in Tarkastus cloud sync.
# Employee setup
1. Install Tarkastus and open Premium.
2. Follow the in-app subscription and registration steps or sign in to an existing account.
3. Open cloud synchronization settings, choose the shared company folder and grant access.
4. Start synchronization.
# Shared data
Customers, sites, supported work reports, associated photos and finished PDFs.
# Private data
Personal settings, inspector profiles, personal templates, signature files, authentication data and personal backups. Signatures and details already included in a shared PDF are visible to recipients.
Synchronization

Synchronization is manual and two-way: local changes are uploaded to Google Drive and colleagues' changes downloaded. Synchronize before and after teamwork.
Conflicting versions are retained to reduce data loss if documents are edited simultaneously. Review conflicts manually. Do not close the app until synchronization finishes.
! Before first connection, make sure your local reports and PDFs may be shared with colleagues.
Backups

Local ZIP backups are free.
# Create backup
1. Open settings and local backup.
2. Choose Save ZIP.
3. Select a location and wait for completion.
Keep archives separate from app data. If needed, save in a private Google Drive folder via Android's file picker.
# Restore
1. Open backup.
2. Choose Restore ZIP and select the archive.
3. Confirm.
! Restoring may replace current data. Create a fresh backup first. A shared company folder is not a substitute for a personal backup.
Transfer to another device

1. Create a personal ZIP on the old device.
2. Save it somewhere accessible.
3. Install the corresponding Tarkastus version on the new device.
4. Restore the ZIP.
5. Verify documents, photos and settings.
6. With Premium, sign in and reconnect the shared folder.
Do not uninstall the old app before verifying the transfer.
Offline use

Without a permanent internet connection, create and edit local reports, take photos, use saved customers, sites and templates, create PDFs and local backups.
Internet is needed for registration, sign-in, subscription verification, password recovery and cloud synchronization.
Security

Biometric protection is available to registered users on supported devices. Lock your phone and do not share passwords. The system is designed for a personal account per employee.
When an employee leaves, the folder owner revokes access directly in Google Drive. Signing out is not the same as deleting local documents.
Subscription and account management

In Premium, check subscription status and use the available purchase restoration options. When Premium ends, individual features remain available.
Delete a registered account using the corresponding settings option. Save documents and backups before deleting an account or app.
Frequently asked questions

? Is Tarkastus free?
Yes. All individual report creation and editing features are free.
? Is registration mandatory?
No, not for individual work.
? What is Premium for?
Only teamwork and synchronization between users via Google Drive. Active Premium also removes ads.
? Can I create documents offline?
Yes.
? Can I use my own logo?
Yes, upload it in settings.
? Can I create my own documents?
Yes, use custom fields, templates or free-form documents.
? Can I create reports in different languages?
Yes, PDF language is independent of the interface.
? Are my descriptions translated automatically?
No, manually entered text remains unchanged.
? Does a PDF recipient need Tarkastus?
No, PDFs open in standard viewers.
? Where is my data stored?
On your device for individual use. For teamwork, permitted shared data is also stored in the selected Google Drive folder.
? What if sync fails?
Check internet, Premium status, selected folder and permissions.
? How does Pro differ?
It adds a dedicated wet-room waterproofing inspection report.
Responsibility

Tarkastus is a tool for documenting professional work. It does not replace qualifications, professional judgment, mandatory requirements, measuring instruments or manufacturers' instructions. Users are responsible for the accuracy of information, document content and conclusions.
